k_bump_is_derived: k_bump == 10.0 * k_sheet, held fixed by construction. The mesh has ONE free parameter, not two. Tying them is what makes U exactly proportional to 1/(k*r), so strap geometry is selected in closed form with no search (solver property 2).
note: Two global technology constants for the whole corpus. A design's conductances are k * (strap_width_um / strap_pitch_um), both of which are published in design_stats.csv, so feature extraction reproduces them without touching the fine solve. S8 refits these two numbers against the real signoff map.
